description: Department of Co-operative Development - Order to confer the powers on Mr. Kariyawasam Manage Muditha Chaminda to assist the Commissioner of Co-operative Development and the Register of Co-operative Societies with effect from 24.11.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns the conferment of powers under specific cooperative society laws and amendments. It references multiple legislative acts (Co-operative Societies Law No. 5 of 1972, Amendment Acts No. 32 of 1983 and No. 11 of 1992) and delegates regulatory powers to appointed officials. While it mentions a minister by name, the core content is about legal/regulatory framework implementation rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio descriptions, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
